invariants: Parent and child are pre-existing stable Asset identities.
Relationship changes do not transfer ownership.
Launch or deployment does not clone a child Asset.
Moving a child between parents requires an explicit transfer.
Self-containment, arbitrary cycles, duplicate child relationships and implicit second-parent relationships fail closed.
Missing Assets and removal/launch of absent relationships fail closed.
Known governed capacity is enforced when maximum, usage and requested load are known.
Unknown capacity, usage or requested load remains unresolved and is never treated as zero or unlimited.
OARC-05 persists no owner state and creates no duplicate containment ledger.
future_handoff: OARC-06 may compose these verified relationship semantics into source-backed golden workflows without creating owner mutation authority or hidden MERA/MBES implementation.
